  • Pānui - July 2026

    Published date
    30 July 2026
    The government financial year ended on 30 June 2026, and LINZ is now preparing our annual performance reporting. Some of the key highlights are set out in this edition of Pānui.
    Topic
    Overseas investment

  • SouthPAN supports safer, more resilient pilotage at Port of Auckland

    Published date
    21 July 2026
    A new case study shows how SouthPAN is helping Port of Auckland strengthen positioning resilience in one of New Zealand’s busiest and most complex harbour environments.
    Topic
    Data Geodetic

  • Kauri protection platform Kete Aronui recognised with international geospatial award

    Published date
    15 July 2026
    A New Zealand-developed platform helping protect iconic Kauri trees has been recognised internationally for its use of geospatial technology.
    Topic
    Geodetic

  • Modernising Landonline programme closure report published - delivered on time and under budget

    Published date
    14 July 2026
    Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand has published a report on the Survey and Title Enhancement Programme (STEP), providing a full summary of the main delivery phase for the modernisation of Landonline.
    Topic
    Landonline
